description: This pie chart illustrates the "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," representing the breakdown of token resolution across three distinct categories. The chart consists of three slices of varying sizes. The overwhelmingly dominant segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL," accounts for 94.5% of the total. The second largest slice is colored red, labeled "LLM," and represents 3.9% of the distribution. The smallest slice, colored blue and labeled "EDGE_P2P," makes up the remaining 1.6%. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, the category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of their respective slices, while the corresponding percentage values are displayed directly inside each colored segment. None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting. Visually, the segments are arranged such that the two smaller slices are adjacent to each other, contrasting sharply with the single large category.
